title: CLG VerificationRecord
description: Generic, independent evidence object recording that a specific method, applied by a specific verifier to a specific subject, produced a specific result. Result UNKNOWN must be treated as not-passed by consumers. A verifier statement is not a business outcome and a dispatch receipt is not a verification.

subject_digest.description: Digest of the exact subject bytes/artifact state that was verified (mutation detection), where applicable.
